about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of “Damsels in Distress” with the official soundtrack, featuring original compositions created specifically for the game. Each track reflects key story moments, heightens the intensity of battles, and conveys the magical beauty of the game’s locations.

Emotional Palette: From majestic orchestral themes to gentle lyrical motifs that perfectly underscore the fates of the heroes.
Immersion in the Game: The music creates a cohesive soundscape with the game world, evoking memories of the most vivid moments from your playthrough.
For Fantasy Enthusiasts: This soundtrack is an excellent choice for fans of the genre, bringing enchanting and grand musical compositions to your collection.
Whether you want to relive your favorite scenes or simply seek an inspiring fantasy soundtrack, this collection will take you on an unforgettable musical journey.

content_descriptors.notes:
The narrative includes themes of a sexual nature, including master-slave relationships, thought-provoking content, and exploration of dark desires.
Violence in the game is limited, however, combat includes hand-to-hand and ranged combat (including blood).
Damsels in Distress contains depictions of sexual acts, including, among others, BSDM "master/slave", gratuitous nudity, bodily fluids and blood, "coercive role play" by mutual consent, and much more. Depiction of zoophilia in the game is absent.
All characters are over 18 years old.
